text: This submitted report on the Board's Delegation Schedule is to satisfy the annual requirements of Article 4 of the Financial By-law No. 2-18 that is effective January 1, 2023.

The Board of Governors of Exhibition Place: 1. Approved the Delegation Schedule, attached as Appendix A to the report (November 24, 2022) from the Chief Executive Officer, Exhibition Place, prepared pursuant to Article 4 of Financial By-law No. 2-18, to be effective January 1, 2023.
